about: What a redaction of part of a span's text takes, by code point. Each `widened` case is a range and the whole words it takes, without spaces at either end, or null where it takes none; each `merged` case is a span's ranges, and the runs they make together. Read by tests/editing/test_redacted_words.py and react/src/editing/redaction.test.ts: the browser widens a selection, and merges a span's redactions, as the server does.

widened.what: inside a word: the whole word
a space either side: no word to take
punctuation selected stays, and isn't widened past
a mark on a letter is part of its word
a letter past the first 65,536 is one code point
only a next line (U+0085), a space to the server: none
only a file separator (U+001C), a space to the server: none
a zero-width no-break space isn't one: it stays

merged.what: apart: each its own run, in the text's order
meeting end to start: one run
